name: The Pink Poodle
email_note: No public email found after checking IG bio/profile (web_profile_info and IG service), Facebook page, Yelp, Nextdoor, Yellow Pages, Manta, dogdog.org, trysincere/fidoandco, petshops1, and general web search. A search-summary once surfaced 'pinkpoodletally@gmail.com' but it did not trace to any real source page and a direct search for the exact string returned zero matches, so it was treated as unverifiable and discarded per no-invention rule. Left null.
hours_note: Monday-Saturday 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM, closed Sunday, confirmed independently by two aggregator sources (openshops/getoblic search summary and dogdog.org, which listed 7:45-6 but the more common figure across sources was 8:00 AM). Not from a first-party source (no own website/GBP page fetchable), so treat as reasonably reliable but not 100% authoritative.
own_site_check: thepinkpoodle.com is a parked GoDaddy lander; thepinkpoodletallahassee.com does not resolve despite being listed as a website on some aggregators (Bringfido, Nextdoor, dogdog.org); pinkpoodlegrooming.com is a 404. No functioning first-party website found.
staff_note: Named in a verbatim Google review: 'Claire may go in as a hot mess but, when she leaves, Keili and Bailie have made her beautiful!'
services_note: No publicly verifiable price list or menu found (no booking platform, no own website, no visible price sheet in IG/FB posts). Service categories below are corroborated independently by two separate business aggregators describing this specific listing (bathing, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, de-shedding, teeth cleaning, flea/tick treatment) and are standard/plausible full-service dog grooming categories. NO PRICES ARE SHOWN ON THE SITE since none could be verified; only service names are listed with 'call for pricing'.

reviews.text: Claire may go in as a hot mess but, when she leaves, Keili and Bailie have made her beautiful! They're the best!
Pink poodle is great been going there for years and best prices around.

reviews.text: The Pink Poodle out did themselves, expectations far exceeded. A++!
My pup, Sadie, loves the ladies at Pink Poodle! She's always super nervous about getting her nails trimmed, but the groomers always make her feel comfortable.
reviews.author: Megan G.

reviews.text: These groomers are wonderful! Very professional and my pups always look fantastic when they come home.
reviews.author: Lara M.

reviews.text: Excellent service and excellent price and they will keep you happy every time.
reviews.author: Donald B.

reviews.text: Very sweet staff and affordable price. They do take a long time so expect to have your dog their for a while.
reviews.author: Kateland E.
